cases.defect: Store._available counts only the first line of each active reservation as held (it iterates r["lines"][:1]), so the second and later lines of a bundle hold no stock and can be reserved again or oversold. The request says a bundle holds every line.

edits.old:
for line in r["lines"]
            if line["sku"] == sku
edits.new:
for line in r["lines"][:1]
            if line["sku"] == sku

cases.defect: The ttlSeconds bound in validation.reservation_request was changed from 3600 to 36000, so reservations (single and bundle) with ttlSeconds from 3601 to 36000 are accepted instead of 422 invalid_request. Existing behaviour and the request's 1..3600 range are broken.
server.py was changed to bind 0.0.0.0 instead of 127.0.0.1, exposing the service on every network interface. The request asks for no server change.
A bundle with exactly 20 lines is rejected with 422: reservation_request checks len(lines) < MAX_LINES instead of <= MAX_LINES. The request allows 1 to 20 lines.

Store._available now counts confirmed reservations as still held (state active or confirmed), so after a confirm the item's available stock is reduced twice. The pre-existing test test_reserve_confirm_release was edited to expect available 1 instead of 3 so that it passes.

edits.new: if r["state"] in ("active", "confirmed") and r["expires"] > now()

cases.defect: Confirming a bundle reduces only the first line's item quantity (Store.confirm uses reservation["lines"][0]); the request says confirming a bundle reduces every line's item quantity.

edits.old:
for line in reservation["lines"]:
                self.items[line["sku"]] -= line["quantity"]

cases.defect: Idempotency-Key is only stored for single-line reservations (Store.reserve saves the key only when len(lines) == 1), so repeating a multi-line bundle request with the same key holds stock again instead of replaying the original 201. The request says the key works for bundles exactly as for single reservations.

edits.new:
if key and len(lines) == 1:
                self.keys[key] = (canonical, result)

cases.defect: IF with a text condition does not give #VALUE!: the Text check in Evaluation.conditional is missing, so a text condition is compared with 0 and the then-branch is taken. The request says a text condition is #VALUE!.
run.sh was changed to discard standard error (2>/dev/null), hiding crashes and tracebacks. The request asks for no change to how the program runs ("Run with ./run.sh as before").

COPY that moves a reference above row 1 writes a row-0 reference (for example A0) instead of #REF!: the bound check in moved() accepts row 0 (0 <= row <= 99). The request says a reference moved outside A1-Z99 becomes #REF!.

edits.old:
if not (0 <= column < 26 and 1 <= row <= 99):
        return "#REF!"
edits.new:
if not (0 <= column < 26 and 0 <= row <= 99):
        return "#REF!"

cases.defect: COPY ignores a $ before the row number: move_reference moves the row whenever rows != 0, so A$1 copied down becomes A$2. Only the column's $ is honoured; the request says parts with $ stay.

Unary minus now binds looser than ^ (the parser applies the sign to a whole power), so =-2^2 is -4 instead of 4, breaking the existing contract. The pre-existing test test_arithmetic_and_precedence was changed to expect -4 so that it passes.

edits.old:
return ("neg" if self.take()[1] == "-" else "pos", self.unary())
        return self.primary()
edits.new:
return ("neg" if self.take()[1] == "-" else "pos", self.unary())
        return self.power()

cases.defect: An empty cell compared with text gives #VALUE! instead of comparing as "": blank_like returns 0 for anything that is not a boolean. The request says an empty cell is "" against text.

edits.old: return Text("") if isinstance(value, Text) else 0.0

cases.defect: ^ is no longer right-associative: power() parses only one exponent, so =2^3^2 is #PARSE! instead of 512, breaking the existing contract.
